name: Scheduling, Reminders & Dispatch
summary: Fill calendars, cut no-shows, backfill cancellations, and route crews without phone tag.
description: Every empty appointment slot and every wasted drive is revenue you cannot get back. Scheduling is also where small businesses lose the most time to back-and-forth messages. These automations handle booking, confirmations, reminders, waitlists, rebooking, and dispatch updates, so the calendar fills itself and your team spends its time serving customers instead of coordinating them.
